sources.finding: An explicit legacy --output json selects quietProgressTextOutputLayer, even when resolved --output-format is json. This selection happens after resolving the requested structured format.
The wrapper retains the base text format and suppresses only transient task/progress output. It is not the JSON success emitter.
The text branch writes a human completion line to stdout. Only the non-text branch calls the structured success emitter. Dry-run plan/progress writes are separately directed to stderr.
The JSON layer writes the final success object to stdout and logs/progress to stderr. The required six-field push object is correct only when this layer is actually selected.
